public_rationale: On April 21, 2026, Zitron made the call that by the end of 2026 a majority of AI services would move some or all of their customers to token-based billing. The deadline has not passed, so the forecast is not yet due. It is recorded before its deadline.
limitations: 'AI services' is not defined, so the record may not be scorable after the deadline either.

statement.excerpt: I’m making the call that by the end of 2026, a majority of AI services will move some or all of their customers to token-based billing

from_speaker: will move some or all of their customers
as they reckon with the true costs of running AI models
our_interpretation: We read 'by the end of 2026' as on or before 2026-12-31.
The speaker does not say which services count as 'AI services', so no population exists to count a majority against.
'As they reckon with the true costs' gives his reason. It is not tested.
criteria.support_condition: By 2026-12-31, more than half of a defined population of AI services had moved some or all customers to token-based billing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By 2026-12-31, half or fewer of a defined population of AI services had moved any customers to token-based billing.
